fact: The Egyptian Healthcare Authority reported in July 2026 that its health information system runs in 265 primary care units, its laboratory system in 299 facilities and RIS/PACS in 94, with results linked to the electronic medical record.
title: تشغيل منظومة المعلومات الصحية داخل 265 مركزًا ووحدة للرعاية الأولية
